It features N.O.S. Motorola 2N5133 transistors, metal film resistors, and metallized polyester film capacitors to deliver vintage tone with reduced noise. Despite its small size, the Li’l Beaver uses all through-hole components and panel mounted hardware. It also has true bypass functionality. The main difference between the various versions of the Li’l Beaver is the type of enclosure used. However, this information has been removed from the summary.
